source_identity: All43 original data/code identities plus the current bounded scientific/entry/source-contract implementation fingerprint. Operator qualification binds programme_digest, admission_digest and implementation_digest; all process observations bind the same implementation_digest.

candidate_views.A: Paper, data and common clarified mathematical task contract, within the current reproduction or training/query phase only.
candidate_views.B: Same as A plus the authenticated complete author implementation. Author code remains absent from A.
candidate_views.reference: Independent trusted producer with the same permitted train/query boundaries. Evaluator/reference source is absent from both candidate views.

phase_executor: execute(phase, parent_artifacts, original_origin_ns, absolute_deadline_ns, binding_digest) returns phase_id, binding_digest, plain-JSON artifact and producer receipt. Artifact arrays are operator-owned bounded transports, not embedded JSON data or candidate paths opened by the controller.
independent_observer: observe(phase, raw_producer_result, original_origin_ns, absolute_deadline_ns, binding_digest) must externally observe and log natural termination, integer exit code, all descendants closed, exact original clock, aggregate logical read/write/retained/live resource usage, view isolation and unchanged source/model seals. It is called on producer exceptions and malformed returns; failed-attempt accounting persists outside the success return.
resource_semantics: Duration covers the original entire study including policy work, graph creation, all attempts, preparation, fits, queries, closures and grading. Read/write are cumulative actual logical transfer, retained bytes are conservative cumulative positive retained allocations (never offset by deletions), live bytes are actual maximum whole-owned-tree live high-water per phase. Executor/observer enforce CPU/RAM/disk/process limits externally and include their own metadata/bundle costs. Shared baseline storage is not silently free.
complete_fit_seal: fit_models and fit_receipts maps with all14 actual configuration keys; every value must equal that configuration's independently closed fit artifact. Source/parameter/training-transform seals precede any query-feature exposure.
query_artifact: seal_digest binds the actual complete fit seal; no response or protected target body is made available.
prediction_artifact: The same sealed model_digest and fit_receipt_digest; observer must report identical model_digest_after_inference. Source/isolation review must additionally reject query-dependent fitting or normalization performed in memory.
native_output_schema: A complete response-value-free metadata/array shape/dtype schema is independently fixed from admitted original headers, row-index manifests and complete producer contracts before candidate evaluation. Do not derive expected schemas from candidate output. All raw coefficient/support/RNG/summary diagnostics remain required.
target_last: grade_study validates every actor's complete reproduction and prediction outputs against independently fixed schemas, then requires exact immutable bundle and external closure bindings before one actual protected loader invocation. Only the final planned grading phase owns this capability.
not_authorized: source publication or article redistribution now
fit_observer_binding: For every actual fit the independent observer reports fit_receipt_digest and model_digest_after_fit; both must equal the producer artifact before it can enter the complete fit seal.
scientific_composition: The installed source-owned lib/dispatcher.py maps each phase kind to the actual production packet, reference, reproduction, independent schema and grading functions. External runtime/monitor factories cannot replace the scientific dispatcher. The private per-phase class is a trusted engineering seam; production create_dispatcher validates the complete original admission.
response_units: Every case must independently establish original Hz and unchanged prepared Hz: scale1, offset0, source_unit_receipt and packet_target_join_receipt. Exactly the same response_units object binds fit dimensions, sealed model, query dimensions, prediction schema and protected target. Unknown/non-Hz units refuse the Hz² contract; physical clock units are separate.
deadline: Strictly before the original whole-study deadline, including every phase closure and the single captured final completion timestamp. Equality fails. Return exactly the checked final timestamp; never read a later unchecked clock for the result.
runtime_methods: run_reference(name, fixed_source_callable, packet, context, binding, implementation_digest)
monitor_methods: close_fit(context, case, stored_artifact, actual_model_digest, actual_input_digest, binding)
observe_phase(phase, producer_result, original_origin, deadline, binding, implementation_digest)
